title: Dark Displacement Gloves

sources.title: Subtle Swap
markers: | summary = '''Subtle Swap''' is a passive feature that improves throwing ability and potentially swaps position with the target.

summary: Gain +1 Sleight of Hand and +1 to throwing attack rolls. A thrown weapon can swap you with its target.

fields.Base value: 160 gp in standard modes, 500 gp in Honour Mode.
fields.Subtle Swap: +1 to throwing attack rolls. A thrown weapon hit forces a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure, trade places with the target. Throwing a potion or poison does not cause a swap.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
